verdict.line: You win if you all-in during levels 3-5 before Siphoning Strike's stacks snowball Nasus; you lose if the lane stalls past level 10 and he out-farms you into an unkillable split-pusher.

brief.thesis: Jax's full combo comes online before Nasus has any way to escape it, which is why Jax holds both the lane and solo-kill edge on paper. But Siphoning Strike's stacking and Fury of the Sands scale Nasus independently of the lane result, which is why the raw head-to-head win rate (47.7% over 1791 games) sits slightly under Jax's overall baseline (49.4%) despite that early advantage.

theirWindow.what: Nasus will chain autos for Soul Eater lifesteal and free Siphoning Strike damage while you're slowed. Only trade back if Counter Strike is up; otherwise walk toward your minions to break his follow.

yourWindow.what: Engage with Leap Strike into Empower, then bait his attack-back into Counter Strike for the stun. Without a slow he has no way to escape or punish the dive.

start.why: Picked in 70.9% of games at 48.5% win rate — the early AD and sustain win short trading windows against Siphoning Strike's 255-range pokes.

runes.keystoneWhy: This page runs 51.8% over 10.9% of games — against Nasus's constant Siphoning Strike pokes and Wither harassment, Grasp's max-health scaling damage and heal let Jax win extended trades without needing a perfect E engage every time.

summoners.why: Run in 75% of games; Ignite converts Jax's measured solo-kill advantage into real kills during the levels 3-5 window, when Nasus has no escape from the Leap Strike all-in.

playing.title: All-in before stacks matter
playing.detail: Engage levels 3-5 with Leap Strike into Empower into Counter Strike. Siphoning Strike's bonus damage only compounds with kills, so he's weakest before he's farmed meaningful stacks.

playing.title: Track Wither's cooldown
playing.detail: It's 15/14/13/12/11 seconds. Only commit to a long trade when it's down — otherwise he slows your movement and attack speed and peels free damage.

playing.title: Time Counter Strike on autos, not Q
playing.detail: E dodges his basic attacks, not Siphoning Strike itself. Hold it for the moment he commits to auto-trading, then stun and burst.

playing.title: Don't stand in Spirit Fire
playing.detail: It's a 650-range ground zone that strips armor on anyone standing in it. Step out rather than trading through the pool.

playing.title: Respect but don't fear his ult
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands only has 400 range and a 120-second cooldown. Poke from outside that range rather than standing in sustained melee once he's level 6.

playing.title: Never push a wave into him
playing.detail: Siphoning Strike's stack growth comes from last hits. Freeze instead of shoving minions under his tower, or you're handing him free scaling.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from real games on the current patch (16.19.1); the power-curve and trade-pattern reasoning is my own read of the two kits, not itself measured data.
